# SD13-E5 druid level 2 prepared divine spell-burden baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Druid level 2 identity as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity
# values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and bonus-feat)
# and stays a single-class, level-2 prepared divine spell-bearing baseline, mirroring
# the level-1 fixture's shape with the class level swapped.
#
# It deliberately avoids every spell-support surface: no spellbook, no spells prepared,
# no spell slots, no spell DCs, no bonus spells, no nature-bond power execution, and no
# general spell totals. It adds only the minimum choice data needed to make the Druid
# class identity, the nature bond / wild empathy burden, and the prepared divine spell
# posture burden legible; those burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and
# matrix to name as still blocking.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-druid-level2
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:druid:2
ability=strength:10
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:8
ability=wisdom:17
ability=charisma:12
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:druid_nature_bond:bond:animal_companion
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:wisdom
